description: All Northwestern students, faculty and staff can access Copilot Chat with their university account. Exact data classes and course permissions remain separate.
howToObtain: Sign in using Northwestern credentials to the institutional Copilot Chat environment.
costToUser: Free Copilot Chat is expressly stated in the current IT getting-started guide.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Microsoft Copilot is the primary, general-use AI tool available at Northwestern. All Northwestern students, faculty, and staff have access to the free Copilot Chat, and faculty and staff can use the full Copilot for Microsoft 365 Copilot capabilities with an add-on paid subscription. When you are logged into these services with your Northwestern NetID, your data is protected and operates fully within Northwestern’s security, compliance, and data boundaries.

Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium
Claude Enterprise
ChatGPT Business

Data and security: Claude Enterprise is provided under Northwestern's enterprise agreement with Anthropic. See Northwestern's Tools and Use Guidance for current guidance on permitted data. Some sponsored research requirements, particularly certain Department of Defense-funded projects, restrict the use of Anthropic products. Confirm applicable grant, funding, and data requirements before using Claude for sponsored research.

costToUser: Eligible school-funded subscriptions; no general student entitlement or current per-seat price asserted.

Note: Microsoft Copilot Chat is free and available to all staff with a Northwestern Microsoft 365 account — no subscription needed. Access it directly at msoffice.northwestern.edu. For more information, see Copilot Chat at Northwestern. Eligibility for paid tools may expand over time.

Personal ChatGPT accounts and the Kellogg ChatGPT Business workspace are separate environments. When you join the Kellogg workspace you will access it using your Kellogg email. Conversations from your personal account do not automatically transfer. If you wish to retain anything from your personal account, save it before switching.
If you choose to merge your personal workspace into the Kellogg Business workspace, your personal data will move into the Business workspace and your personal workspace will be permanently deleted. This action is irreversible. For step-by-step guidance, see Managing workspace lifecycle and migration.

As with any digital tool, responsible use remains important. Please do not enter confidential student information or regulated research data into these tools, and review AI-generated outputs carefully before using them in teaching or research. While Kellogg's versions of ChatGPT and Claude do not train on your inputs, confidential student information and regulated research data should still not be entered.

A: No. Conversations created within a Kellogg-provided AI workspace stay within that workspace. They do not follow you to a personal account or another workspace, even if you use the same email address. If your Kellogg subscription is cancelled, your access to the workspace ends, or you leave Kellogg, you will no longer have access to the conversations and other content stored there.

description: Northwestern provides Panopto, but research-interview guidance says it should not be used with non-public research data. Research recording tools have separate safeguards.
howToObtain: Check the university service and research recording workflow; availability does not authorize non-public research uploads.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Transcription services not listed below, such as Rev or Otter.ai, should not be used with Northwestern research data. Panopto, a Northwestern service, should not be used with non-public research data.
Record to your computer, not the cloud, in order to securely store recorded files and prevent them from being backed up to Panopto.
